list.title: U nwalisa
list.empty: A hu na u ṅwaliswa hu tshimbilelanaho na zwiṱuṱuwedzi izwi.

override.title: Admin o fhirisa
override.hint: Overrides dzi dzula dzo ṅwaliwa na vhuḓiṱalusi ha admin na muhumbulo - a dzi vhuyi dza fhumula.
override.cancelBookingHint: U khansela zwi swaya u buka na khomishini yazwo sa zwo khanselwaho, zwi vhuisa vhuṋe ha mushumo kha mufarisani, na u tendela mufhaṱi u buka vhurangaphanḓa uhu hafhu.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Kha vha khantsele vhupo uhu? Khomishini yayo na yone yo khanselwa. Hezwi zwo ṅwaliwa na dzina ḽaṋu na tshiitisi.

detail.disputeOpen: Khanedzano ya vhuṋe yo vulea kha khasiṱama iyi - muṅwe mufarisi u ri ndi yawe. I dzhia tsheo kha siaṱari ḽa Dzikhakhathi.

cancellation.title: U buka zwo khanselwa
cancellation.hint: U buka na khomishini yazwo zwi a khanselwa; vhuṋe ha mushumo ho vhuya na mufarisani nahone mufhaṱi a nga dovha a buka vhurangaphanḓa uhu.

disputes.title: Khanedzano dza vhuṋe
disputes.hint: Mufarisani we u ṅwaliswa hawe ha hanelwa sa kopi a nga hanedza uri ndi nnyi ane a vha muṋe wa khasiṱama. Vusulusani masia oṱhe nahone ni dzhie phetho.

detail.title: Khanedzano {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: U ṅwaliswa ho farwaho a ho ngo wanala.
detail.decideTitle: Kha vha dzhie tsheo kha khanedzano iyi .
detail.noteRequired: Ṅwalani notsi u itela u dzhia phetho.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} u vhulunga khasiṱama. Khanedzano yo vala ahuna zwinwe zwine zwa shanduka.
detail.overturnEffect: Tsireledzo ya u dovholola {{holder}} i fhela zwino nahone khasiṱama yo ṅwaliswa kha {{partner}} sa u ṅwaliswa huswa.
detail.heldBookedHelp: Murengi uyu o bookiwa nga muṋe wa zwino. Kha vha thome nga u khansela u buka honoho (Admin Override kha u ṅwalisa), vha kone u fhirisela murahu:
